text:
maya: Quick ask 11 We need a focused bench probe for the launch post. Not a full sweep 1 just a smoke and a small variance sample. Can runtime run a 250-query probe and deliver artifacts in 48h?

ajay: On it. can you list exact deliverables so we don't miss anything?

maya: Minimal artifacts: 1) per-request CSV with latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_tag; 2) aggregate table (p50/p90/p99, avg tokens, estimated cost); 3) warmup vs coldstart heatmap; 4) sample payload CSV + runner command; 5) one quantized-variant example if available.

sophia: add: mark any failed requests and error classes, and include the exact seed CSV (we need it reproducible). Also call out which model variants count as "compatible fallback" for claims.

maya: seed file uploaded here: https://redwood.co/samples/launch-250.csv. Runner we want used: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1:2026-03-10","input_file":"launch-250.csv","max_tokens":256,"stream":false}' 
Try quantized tag rw-large-v1-q4_0 if staging supports quantization.

leo: tagging runtimebot for visibility 1 @runtimebot can you confirm availability and ETA?

runtimebot: job queued: jb_2026_03_23_mkt_001. Est runtime 2.5h on staging-gpu-2. Quantized path available on staging but may fall back to rw-medium under heavy load.

ajay: I'll own the handoff and packaging. marketing wants smoke artifacts by EOD +2 days; we'll gate on a sanity run.

sophia: checklist for artifacts bundle: per-request CSV, aggregate metrics, heatmap image, failed-request log, runner_cmd.txt (redacted env vars).

maya: last constraint 1 if quantized p99 > baseline p99 by >15% abort the quantized claim and log config. We'll present quantized as "in progress" with the delta noted.

runtimebot: job jb_2026_03_23_mkt_001 completed (2h46m). Artifacts saved: /artifacts/jb_2026_03_23_mkt_001/ (latency.csv, aggregates.csv, heatmap.png, failed.log, runner_cmd.txt). Quantized p99 = +12% vs baseline. No request failures.

ajay: pulling artifacts now, will prepare a one-slide summary + 1-paragraph caveat. ETA ~12h.

maya: thanks 1 include a footnote in the blog and full appendix for the webinar.

sophia: perfect. closing the loop here unless SRE flags packaging issues. :thumbsup:
